security_privacy_cost_impact: None at run time. No migration, policy, index, grant or role changes; nothing reachable by any role changes. The batch adds four lint files, four probes run by make db-migrate-clean (CI already runs it), static tests, a synthetic fixture generator and an EXPLAIN harness that runs only where DB_TEST_URL names an allowlisted host, in one transaction that is rolled back. The fixture is synthetic by construction (derived ids, no address, no customer data). Cost: four more probes per migrate-clean (5.2 s measured on this branch); the harness at full WS:905 scale needs about 2 GB of free disk while its transaction is open, and the draft's full-scale run filled the volume once (plan §6.2); it was run here at small and 0.2 scale only.
migration_and_data_impact: NONE. Batch 150's prerequisites add no migration and need no migration number.
compatibility_impact: Additive. Tests stay 684 (no test added or renamed); foundation-contract's assertion floor 793 -> 878, the guard's own count; test floors and name digests unchanged; no existing probe digest moves. evidence/VERIFICATION.md is not amended and amends_without_owning.paths is unchanged, so no WP line citation moves. A later batch that rebuilds performance_snapshots, published_posts or usage_events, adds or changes a vocabulary CHECK, adds a policy anywhere, or adds an RLS predicate column without an index must update the matching lint file in the same diff, or migrate-clean names it.
known_limitations: The pinned shapes pin no column (type, NOT NULL, default, identity) -- F7, owed to A0 with Q150-a (open_blockers[194] (4)).

Index-coverage rule 1 reads only the USING columns of a policy's own table; a helper's internal lookup and the parent lookups inside a narrowing's EXISTS are not computed -- F5, IC-2 and IC-3 (open_blockers[194] (5)).
The vocabulary selector reads ARRAY[' and the single-column text equality; OR, regex and domain vocabularies and the other 209 CHECKs are outside it -- F6 (open_blockers[194] (6)).
The policy set reads policies, not RLS flags; enabled and forced RLS beyond the three shape tables is held by the static lint and rls-smoke -- F8.
The scripts that generated the four lint files are not in the repository -- F10.
The harness is not in CI or the Makefile, the full WS:905 scale is not measured, and the fixture is uniform -- F13, F1, F14.
The probes compare PostgreSQL 17.11 deparse text; CI's postgres:17 rendering identically is inferred -- F9.
